text:
Situation: Lidocaine hydrochloride injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2012-02-22 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 19 days of supply across presentations. Corvale General holds 6 days. Corvale Lakeside holds 3.9 to 4.2 days across presentations.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2012-02-22. Inspection 732886 at Hospira, Inc. ended 2011-06-17 with OAI classification, 250 days before the posting. Inspection 732653 at Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC ended 2011-07-08 with OAI classification, 229 days before the posting. Inspection 740633 at Hospira, Inc. ended 2011-08-04 with OAI classification, 202 days before the posting. Inspection 741861 at Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC ended 2011-08-29 with VAI classification, 177 days before the posting. A Warning Letter was issued to Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC on 2012-02-22, the same day as the shortage posting.

Our position: We have sufficient stock at Corvale East to support internal transfers. Corvale Lakeside and Corvale General are below target days on hand. Alternate manufacturers not on FDA's shortage list are available.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 204 units from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
2. Transfer 227 units from Corvale East to Corvale General — needs pharmacy director approval of transfer request.
3. Purchase from Avenacy, LLC — needs buyer approval.
4. Use alternate manufacturer Lidocaine Hydrochloride 20 mg/mL from Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC — needs pharmacist approval.
5. Purchase from A-S Medication Solutions — needs buyer approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
